messages:
morgan: quick postmortem from today's onboarding smoke. found a couple weird modes that slipped past the gate.

kai: summary please.

morgan: two failure classes: (A) wheel contains fused ops that runtime image doesn't support -> runtime dispatch falls back to slow path and OOMs; (B) microbench OK but long-format inputs trigger kv-cache fragmentation and a perf cliff when sharded.

anya: (A) sounds like op-level compatibility. we currently only check model metadata and shapes. need op-list vs image capability intersection.

morgan: agreed. action: op-list should be emitted by wheel-build (best-effort) and stored as metadata key "inferred_ops". model manifest can include "required_ops" for overrides.

kai: infra should publish image capability manifests (ops, quant schemes, fused/unfused support). validator will query that during admission.

infra-bot: INFRA-900 created to add image capability export endpoint.

anya: fallback strategy? if fused missing but unfused available, validator could mark model as "degraded" and allow canary routing to an unfused-compatible runtime. need to record that in registry.

morgan: also add a confidence flag "ops_inferred": "true|false" so we warn authors when inference is uncertain.

kai: (B) for kv fragmentation: add a light "longtail" probe suite that includes longer prompts and cross-chunk attention patterns. not full bench but heavier than microbench.

anya: cost impact: run microbench for fast admit, schedule longtail async. block full production until longtail passes, but allow limited canary traffic. store probe-suite/version and probe-hashes in the model entry.

morgan: propose stability policy: longtail must pass 3-of-5. canary can start with 1-of-3. store policy values in admission ticket.

kai: implementers: morgan -> probe-suite + registry fields; anya -> validator changes + UX; infra -> capability API.

morgan: quick UX note: rejection should include missing ops list and clear remediation steps: rebuild without fused ops, request image bump, or pin an alternate variant. include links to docs.

infra-bot: noted. scheduled follow-up review in RFC meeting on Friday.

kai: i'll prototype op-list extractor tomorrow and open PR.

anya: thanks. will add schema changes to the admission proto and a short author README.
